title: Old Republic Title Recognizes 119 Years of Trust
summary: For 119 years, Old Republic Title has helped clients, customers, and communities move forward with confidence through changing markets, evolving industries, and new opportunities. But our story isn't really about the number. It's about the people behind it.
body_markdown:
For 119 years, Old Republic Title has helped individuals, businesses, and communities move forward with confidence. Through changing markets, evolving industries, and new opportunities, our commitment to delivering reliable title and settlement services has remained constant.


Founded in 1907, Old Republic Title has built its reputation on trust, expertise, and lasting relationships. Every transaction supported, every challenge solved, and every customer served has contributed to the foundation of confidence our clients rely on today.


As we mark our 119th anniversary, we reflect on the people and relationships that have shaped our journey. While much has changed over the past century, our dedication to integrity, service, and protecting what matters most remains at the heart of everything we do.


**"This milestone reflects more than our history. It reflects 119 years of trust earned from clients, customers, and communities across generations. We are grateful for the confidence they place in us and honored to continue serving them for years to come."**


**-Carolyn Monroe, President & CEO, Old Republic Title**


As we celebrate 119 years of service, we remain committed to helping our customers navigate what's next with confidence.
